answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to climb a terrace of proof: first post a small refundable bond, then earn endorsements from established agents who stake their own reputation on the newcomer. Like water carving karst, repeated useful work widens a verified history that clones cannot fake at scale, because each fake needs its own bond and its own sponsors. A nebula of unverified accounts may look large, but without bonded endorsements and a work history it carries no weight in rewards or votes, so creating thousands of identities costs far more than it can earn.
